capabilities: Insert numbered sidenotes in the margin
Edit sidenotes in the margin while editing
Render Pandoc citations as author–year text
Lay out sidenotes in the margin on PDF export
disambiguation: Not a sidebar or side-panel note app; it places notes in the page margin beside the referencing line.
extras: PDF export is marked experimental; 'Restart numbering after each heading' is listed as not working; editing sidenotes in Reading mode was removed because edits could fail to save.
intentEvidence: I did not use a custom callout like this because I wanted the sidenotes to also be publishable.
motivation: The author found sidenotes on Gwern.net, which referenced Edward Tufte's conventions, and wanted them in Obsidian.
problem: Footnotes in Obsidian sit at the bottom of the note, away from the sentence they annotate, so asides are hard to read next to the text.

relations.evidence: I did build some of the functionality in my plugin based on this.
I did not use a custom callout like this because I wanted the sidenotes to also be publishable.
The snippet of CSS I've been using for web publishing is located in /digital-garden/custom-styles.css.

summary: Plugin that shows numbered sidenotes and unnumbered margin notes in the page margin, using HTML spans or Markdown footnotes.
